name: Signed Employment Contract
objective: Extract final agreed salary metrics, start dates, notice periods, and restrictive covenants.

attributes.name: Employee Full Name
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the employee's legal full name.

attributes.name: Employment Type
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify as Full-time, Part-time, Contract or Temporary.

attributes.name: Base Salary
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the agreed base salary amount.

attributes.name: Salary Currency / Frequency
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the salary currency and pay frequency.

attributes.name: Bonus / Variable Pay
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise bonus, commission or variable pay terms.

attributes.name: Signature Date
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the date the contract was signed.
